limits: The guard only protects invocations routed through its hook; direct other tools, collaboration mechanisms, and unrestricted same-UID/root actions can bypass it.
Journal deletion or rewrite by an unrestricted same-UID operator is outside the boundary.
Process-group timeout/termination is best effort for ordinary processes; escaped descendants, daemon work, blocked kernel calls, and hard real-time cleanup are not contained or guaranteed.
